editorial.blurb: A beloved diner where perfectly executed breakfast and dinner shine, served by genuinely warm staff in a nostalgic, well-run space.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the bar during busy times to watch the kitchen and chat with servers like Jonathan or Joaquin—you'll get the full experience and their recommendations are spot-on.

topDishes.note: Cooked in beef tallow with superb seasoning—reviewers call them the best potatoes they've ever had
Fluffy inside with crispy edges and fantastic vanilla flavor
